answer_key_audit.notes: Confirmed: the fix uses 'each NUL-delimited origin URL verbatim'. At the reviewed head policyVeto (line 408) trimmed each URL; the policy script's normalize() does not trim, so an origin such as 'remote.git ' (a valid local path) was looked up under a different key and its deny missed. The fix's CHANGELOG says the hook must refuse a deny remote 'whose local-path URL contains a newline or edge whitespace' and lists 'origin URLs split on newlines or trimmed' among mutations that turn a test red.
